This page lists every command of the `x18n` CLI. [CLI and x18n check](/surfaces/cli) explains how to use them. Run `x18n <command> --help` to see the same text in a terminal.

## Global options

Every command accepts these options.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--root <dir>` | Project root (default: nearest config upward from the cwd) |
| `--config <file>` | Explicit config file |
| `--project <name>` | Pick one project in a monorepo |
| `--json` | Print the JSON contract instead of human output |
| `--no-cache` | Ignore the persistent cache |
| `--yes` | Accept default answers for decisions |
| `-h, --help` | Display the help of a command |
| `-v, --version` | Display the version number |

A repeatable option takes several values: `--locale de --locale fr`. Options that take a list also accept commas: `--only missing-key,unused-key`.

## x18n

```sh
x18n [options]
```

Show the status and the main commands.

## status

```sh
x18n status [options]
```

Locales with coverage, resources, keys and diagnostics.

## keys

```sh
x18n keys [glob] [options]
```

List keys.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--missing <locale>` | Only keys missing or empty in a locale |
| `--unused` | Only keys without usages |
| `--namespace <ns>` | Only keys of a namespace |
| `--values` | Include the value per locale |
| `--limit <n>` | Page size |
| `--cursor <cursor>` | Start of the page (from `nextCursor`) |

## search

```sh
x18n search <query> [options]
```

Find keys by their value in any locale, with their usages.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--exact` | Only values containing the query, instead of a fuzzy match |
| `--limit <n>` | Page size |
| `--cursor <cursor>` | Start of the page |

## get

```sh
x18n get <key> [options]
```

Values, resources, usages and diagnostics of one key.

## usages

```sh
x18n usages [key] [options]
```

Usages of a key, or all usages.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--file <path>` | Only usages in a file |
| `--limit <n>` | Page size |
| `--cursor <cursor>` | Start of the page |

## locales

```sh
x18n locales [options]
```

Locale codes as found, with display names and resources.

## doctor

```sh
x18n doctor [options]
```

How the project was understood: presets, finders, formats, scanners, config origins.

## check

```sh
x18n check [options]
```

Report invalid, untranslated and unused keys, like `tsc --noEmit`.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--watch` | Re-check on change |
| `--strict` | Turn every warning into an error |
| `--locale <locale>` | Only report for these locales (repeatable) |
| `--only <checks>` | Only these check ids (comma separated) |
| `--skip <checks>` | Skip these check ids (comma separated) |
| `--max-warnings <n>` | Fail when there are more warnings |
| `--reporter <id>` | pretty, json, markdown, github or sarif (repeatable) |
| `--output <file>` | Write the matching reporter output to a file (repeatable) |

## set

```sh
x18n set <key> [options]
```

Set one value.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--locale <locale>` | Locale (default: source locale) |
| `--value <value>` | The value; `-` reads stdin |
| `--dry-run` | Print the plan instead of writing |

## apply

```sh
x18n apply <file> [options]
```

Batch set from JSON `{ "<locale>": { "<key>": "<value>" } }`; `-` reads stdin.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--force` | Write values with placeholder problems |
| `--dry-run` | Print the plan instead of writing |

## rename

```sh
x18n rename <from> <to> [options]
```

Rename a key (or every key under a parent) in all locales and usages.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--no-usages` | Keep code unchanged |
| `--dry-run` | Print the plan instead of writing |

## delete

```sh
x18n delete <key> [options]
```

Delete a key (or every key under a parent) in all locales.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--locale <locale>` | Only in these locales (repeatable) |
| `--dry-run` | Print the plan instead of writing |

## fill

```sh
x18n fill [options]
```

Add missing keys with empty values.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--locale <locale>` | Only these locales (repeatable) |
| `--copy-source` | Use the source value instead of an empty string |
| `--dry-run` | Print the plan instead of writing |

## format

```sh
x18n format [options]
```

Re-write resources with the configured sort and indent.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--dry-run` | Print the plan instead of writing |

## extract

```sh
x18n extract [...files] [options]
```

Find hard-coded strings and turn them into keys.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--list` | Print candidates and proposed keys |
| `--plan <file>` | Write the extraction plan to a file to edit |
| `--apply <file>` | Apply an (edited) extraction plan |
| `--dry-run` | Print the plan instead of writing |

## prompt

```sh
x18n prompt <kind> [options]
```

Print a prompt for an agent or LLM: `prompt translate --to <locale>` or `prompt review --locale <locale>`.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--to <locale>` | Target locale (translate) |
| `--locale <locale>` | Locale to review |
| `--keys <glob>` | Only keys matching a glob |
| `--namespace <ns>` | Only keys of a namespace |
| `--limit <n>` | Messages per prompt (default 50) |
| `--cursor <cursor>` | Continue from `nextCursor` |
| `--format <format>` | markdown (default) or json |
| `--no-context` | Leave out code around usages |
| `--stale` | Also translate stale translations (needs git history) |

## ui

```sh
x18n ui [options]
```

Start the UI: browse and edit messages in the browser, with HTTP MCP at /__mcp.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--port <port>` | Port (default: a free one from 9999) |
| `--host <host>` | Bind host (default: localhost) |
| `--no-open` | Do not open the browser |
| `--no-auth` | Skip authentication (CI and e2e only) |

## build

```sh
x18n build [options]
```

Write a static, read-only report of the UI.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--out-dir <dir>` | Output directory (default: .x18n/report) |

## mcp

```sh
x18n mcp [options]
```

Serve the MCP tools over stdio.

## init

```sh
x18n init [options]
```

Detect the setup and write x18n.config.ts.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--format <format>` | ts (default), yml or json |
| `--force` | Replace an existing config |

## migrate

```sh
x18n migrate <source> [options]
```

Convert i18n-ally settings: `migrate i18n-ally`.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--format <format>` | ts (default), yml or json |
| `--dry-run` | Print the files instead of writing |
| `--force` | Replace an existing config |

## schema

```sh
x18n schema [name] [options]
```

Print a JSON Schema: config (default) or plugin.

## plugin

```sh
x18n plugin <action> <file> [options]
```

Plugin tools: `plugin eject <file.yml>` prints the TS equivalent.

## Exit codes

| Exit code | Meaning | Error codes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0` | Success. For `x18n check`: no errors, and no more warnings than `--max-warnings`. |  |
| `1` | `x18n check` found errors or too many warnings, `x18n apply` rejected values, or the command failed with one of these errors. | [X18N2001](/errors/x18n2001), [X18N2002](/errors/x18n2002), [X18N2003](/errors/x18n2003), [X18N2004](/errors/x18n2004), [X18N3001](/errors/x18n3001), [X18N4001](/errors/x18n4001), [X18N4002](/errors/x18n4002), [X18N4005](/errors/x18n4005), [X18N4006](/errors/x18n4006), [X18N4007](/errors/x18n4007), [X18N4008](/errors/x18n4008) |
| `2` | Usage, config or plugin error. Errors without an x18n code also exit with 2. | [X18N0001](/errors/x18n0001), [X18N0002](/errors/x18n0002), [X18N0003](/errors/x18n0003), [X18N1001](/errors/x18n1001), [X18N1002](/errors/x18n1002), [X18N1003](/errors/x18n1003), [X18N1004](/errors/x18n1004) |
| `3` | A decision is needed and no answer was given. Run again with `--yes`. | [X18N4003](/errors/x18n4003) |
| `4` | Files changed while the command ran. Run it again. | [X18N4004](/errors/x18n4004) |
